ops.title: ship --tip-only reads every ancestor at its published head; worktree rm guard skips only a launcher's copied argv tail
ops.body: PR #249 (v0.72.2). Tip-only: stackPlan ran stackSnapshot divergence/dropped-commit checks and stackUsePublication receipt checks on every ancestor before stackKeepsAncestor pinned them. Now stackReadsPublished (tip-only ancestors + o.pinned other-lane branches) takes the remote head without comparing local, and drops a receipt the remote no longer replays. tipOnlyAncestor is the one rule dryRunMoves/Heads/Creates and the real run share. Repro needs the remote rewrite pushed from a SEPARATE clone: a linked-worktree push lands in the shared reflog and hides the receipt refusal. Test TestShipTipOnlyShipsOverADivergedGrandparent. Guard: native.Guard discounts, in each parent of the requester (or self) whose argv ends with the requester argv[1:], only that copied tail; earlier args still count (finder caught a whole-argv skip). Test TestGuardDiscountsTheRequestersLaunchers.
